rationale: Flags subjects with create access to Pods (CIS 5.1.4), a privilege-escalation path, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags subjects with get/list/watch on Secrets (CIS 5.1.2), a secret-exposure risk, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags bindings to the cluster-admin role (CIS 5.1.1), an excessive-permission issue, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags NetworkPolicies whose podSelector matches no deployment, a broken cross-object reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags NetworkPolicy ingress/egress peers whose podSelector matches no deployment, a dangling reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags Services whose selector matches no deployment, a dangling reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags Prometheus ServiceMonitors whose selectors match no Service, a dangling reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags pods running under the default service account instead of a dedicated identity, a permission-scoping issue, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags deployments with no dnsConfig options set, an opt-in opinionated pod-DNS policy outside the smell categories, so other (kube-linter docs).
Flags env valueFrom references to a Secret or ConfigMap not present in the deployment, a reference-consistency problem, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags raw secret values placed in environment variables, a secret-exposure risk, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags Services of forbidden types such as NodePort or LoadBalancer that expose workloads, a network-exposure issue, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags pods sharing the host network namespace, a security-isolation breach, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags pods sharing the host process namespace, a security-isolation breach, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags HPAs with minReplicas below three, reducing fault tolerance and availability, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags containers using the latest (or otherwise invalid) image tag, an image-versioning issue, so image (kube-linter docs).
Flags liveness probes pointing at a port the container does not expose, a probe misconfiguration that breaks runtime health checking, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags deployments with fewer than three replicas, an availability and fault-tolerance issue, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags deployment selectors that do not match the pod template labels, an internal reference inconsistency, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags multi-replica deployments without pod anti-affinity so replicas may share a node, an availability issue, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags containers without a liveness probe, a missing runtime-reliability probe, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags deployments with no node affinity, a scheduling and placement concern, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags containers without readOnlyRootFilesystem, a container-hardening gap, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags containers without a readiness probe, a missing runtime-reliability probe, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags deployments not using a RollingUpdate strategy, risking service disruption during updates, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags pods referencing a service account that does not exist, a dangling reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags deployments not selected by any NetworkPolicy so they accept unrestricted traffic, a network-isolation gap, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags PodDisruptionBudgets whose minAvailable always blocks disruptions, an availability/eviction misconfiguration, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags PDBs that do not set unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy, affecting eviction and availability behaviour, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags deployments reading secrets from environment variables instead of mounted files (CIS 5.4.1), a secret-exposure risk, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags objects lacking an owner email annotation, an example organisational metadata policy, so other (kube-linter docs).
Flags objects lacking an owner label, an example organisational metadata policy, so other (kube-linter docs).
Flags deployment-like objects without an Always/OnFailure restart policy, a fault-tolerance concern, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags containers not set to runAsNonRoot, a privilege issue, so security (kube-linter docs).
Validates resources against the Kubernetes API schema via kubeconform, a configuration-correctness and maintainability check, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags sensitive host directories mounted into containers, a host-isolation breach, so security (kube-linter docs).
Flags YAML keys not in alphabetical order, a purely stylistic rule, so other (kube-linter docs).
Flags containers without CPU requests and limits, a resource-allocation gap, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags containers without memory requests and limits, a resource-allocation gap, so resource (kube-linter docs).
Flags resources deployed to the default namespace (CIS 5.7.1/5.7.4), primarily a namespace-organisation issue, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
Flags wildcards in Role/ClusterRole rules (CIS 5.1.3) that may grant inadvertent access, so security (kube-linter docs).
Checks that containers set ephemeral-storage requests and limits, a resource-allocation check, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that imagePullPolicy is Always so imagePullSecrets are always validated, a pull-policy setting, so image (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that an explicit non-latest image tag is used, an image-versioning issue, so image (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that containers set CPU/memory requests and limits, a resource-allocation check, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that the container security context sets a read-only root filesystem, a hardening control, so security (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that the security context sets a valid non-root UID and GID, a privilege control, so security (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that CronJobs set startingDeadlineSeconds so missed runs do not pile up, a runtime-reliability concern, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that CronJobs have a valid RestartPolicy (OnFailure/Never), a runtime restart-behaviour setting, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks for podAntiAffinity that keeps replicas off the same node, an availability concern, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that each Deployment is targeted by a PodDisruptionBudget, an availability concern, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that the selector labels match the pod template labels, an internal reference consistency check, so hygiene (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that a Deployment has multiple replicas (default min 2), an availability concern, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that Deployments targeted by a Service use RollingUpdate, an availability-during-rollout concern, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that the HPA has multiple minimum replicas (default 2), an availability concern, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that each NetworkPolicy selects at least one Pod, a dangling-reference check, so hygiene (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that every Pod is targeted by a NetworkPolicy, a network-isolation control, so security (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that service-targeted Pods have safe readiness and liveness probe configurations, a runtime-reliability check, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that readiness and liveness probes are not identical, avoiding cascading restarts, so resource (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that each Service selector matches a Pod, a dangling-reference check, so hygiene (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that the Service type is not NodePort, which kube-score source calls insecure and incompatible with NetworkPolicies, so security (kube-score README_CHECKS).
Checks that StatefulSets reference an existing headless serviceName, a cross-object reference check, so hygiene (kube-score README_CHECKS).
